they mirror the DSA decoder to name each Definition and count its instances without building: by meaning a reading of the list of kernel calls, which does not exist yet; placed on vLLM's side as the decoder's mirror

the declared target is the settings source every kernel binding of targets.py reads (TargetProfile's fields); placed on vLLM's side, which makes every kernel-circuits file that takes a TargetProfile import a vLLM-side type
check circuits a request Program returns, neither a served kernel nor the cut; placed with kernel-circuits as Definitions
circuit tooling or circuits of their own (the checkpoint tie, the padded Program's continuation) that are neither a kernel's circuit nor the period's cut; placed with cut
